profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
In the process of scaling - data science education, the worst ever decision
made was to separate content creation and delivery.When I worked for such
institutes, that was not digestible for me. The problem is that when I teach a
piece of code or a slide, I can infer a lot from audience
faces/responses/doubts. So after the class, I feel like coming back and
editing it so that next delivery gets better !! But alas, at all these
institutes, there is a lot of bureaucracy which makes content improvement a
herculean task When I started on my own, I never wanted to separate content
creation, updating and delivery. Any content delivery mechanism, needs
continuous changes by the same person who delivers ! By doing so, I can vouch
that we are 10 times better than leading brands of market. Often very senior
people deliver content which is made by a mediocre team sold by over hyped
marketing and fake sales promises !! I work on following principles 1\.
Content creation and delivery by same team 2\. No marketing spending 3\. No
fake promises on sales pitches !! Be content. Be the content !! Srivatsan

profile_headline: Chief Data Scientist | Data (Big, Huge, Small, Fast, Whatever) | Cloud | Forever Student
post_content:
You might have seen this message floating around. What I see from this message
is one's salary is correlated to business outcome one is expected to deliver
rather technology outcome PhD is also a good time to see how the new algorithm
or idea you are working on can be commercialized as product and taken to
market. Final benefits can be even bigger than what an CEO can earn I see
people calling out business and startups using Tensorflow or Pytorch are more
likely to succeed. Technology is just an mechanism to implement idea, End
customer does not care if product uses Tensorflow or Pytorch, all they care
about is their purpose solved and experience seamless Organization get paid
for business value delivered not technology value. While technology capability
is important but do not get carried away too much by specific technology
